record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare the ability DIAMOND_STORM: Carbink (1 star) and Diancie (2 stars); both range 1, maxPP 100, no passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the factor table and the caster's def (8 / 16 base). NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT: the name DIAMOND_STORM is also the ROCK synergy effect (EffectEnum.DIAMOND_STORM); this record covers only the Ability.DIAMOND_STORM strategy, but that effect matters because it adds Def to the caster.
record.summary: Inherits requiresTarget = true. The caster deals SPECIAL damage equal to its own current Defense x 1 (1 star) / x 1 (2 stars) to every enemy in the 8 adjacent cells, each through handleSpecialDamage (AP-boosted, crit possible only with the ABILITY_CRIT effect). The target parameter is never used. The ROCK synergy effect of the same name (+50 Def, separate mechanism) raises the caster's Def when active, which raises this damage; it is not part of this strategy.

targeting.who: enemies in the 8 cells adjacent to the caster
targeting.note: target is passed to process but not used; only adjacent cells around the caster matter. The caster's own cell is excluded.

geometry.shape: 3x3 block around the caster, center excluded

effects.target: each enemy in the 8 adjacent cells
effects.scaling: requested = caster current def (read at cast time, includes any Def buffs/debuffs and the Rock-synergy +50) x factor. Applied special damage = requested x (1 + AP/100), then x (1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor) on crit where the target's Rocky Helmet sets the factor to 0 and each Black Augurite lowers it by 0.1 (min 0). The target's special defense is then applied inside handleDamage (core-mechanics §A) and the result is takenDamage; shields count as taken damage there.
effects.resolution: requested (def x factor) -> applied specialDamage (AP, crit) -> handleDamage on the target (special defense, shields, floor of 1) -> takenDamage. A target with protect, skydiving or magicBounce takes 0; magicBounce also bounces SPECIAL damage back at the caster.

declaredRaw.note: ROCK synergy effect DIAMOND_STORM: addDefense(50, pokemon, 0, false) on Rock-type units; separate from the ability

effects.scaling: +50 Def (apBoost 0, no crit) applied through addDefense, so Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down applies to the 50 if held; both Carbink and Diancie are listed as Fossil / Rock / Fairy in their class blocks, so the effect applies to them when the Rock synergy reaches that tier.
effects.resolution: not part of the strategy; it only changes pokemon.def before the cast.

starBehavior.note: table index is the casting entity's stars; 1.5 and 3 are not reached at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Only enemies directly adjacent (8 cells) to the caster are hit; no hit if none is adjacent (the PP is still spent).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state; each cast reads the caster's current def again.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage = def x 1 (1 and 2 stars). Requested = def x factor; applied = requested x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor; takenDamage after special defense and shields in handleDamage. The Rock-synergy effect of the same name changes def, not the factor.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, range check for a requiresTarget ability) - only the castAbility gate was read
handleDamage internals (special defense, shield, floor of 1) - taken from core-mechanics §A, not re-traced here
unresolved: NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT: the Rock-synergy effect DIAMOND_STORM is documented only as an input (+50 Def); its tier thresholds and which units receive it were not traced
Whether Rock synergy actually applies to Carbink / Diancie in a given fight depends on board composition (not modelled)
Whether the two units reach a different star count than the factory value
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
